description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a 10-person engineering team as its first product engineer in New York, working closely with the CTO. You will combine hands-on engineering and product judgment to turn customer needs into useful AI-powered workflows, from initial conversations through launch and adoption.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Talk with customers, use the product firsthand, and turn ambiguous needs into straightforward solutions.

 - Build agents and product features across the stack, connecting models with tools, data, and customer-facing interfaces.

 - Develop workflows such as creating a contest from a campaign brief and helping creators move from invitation to published content.

 - Test the end-to-end brand and creator experience, then improve it using customer feedback, usage data, and agent evaluations.

 - Use AI coding tools to accelerate development, verify their output, and communicate decisions through demos and code reviews.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Entry-to-mid-career experience building and maintaining products across frontend and backend, including production-scale backend systems.

 - Strong TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL skills.

 - Experience designing APIs and web services and shipping customer-facing web application features.

 - Experience owning product work from customer conversations through launch and adoption.

 - Experience building agents or AI-powered features, and using AI coding tools while carefully validating their output.

 - Creator marketing or e-commerce experience is relevant; experience at a large technology company is also useful.

 - Based in or relocating to New York and available to work in the office three days per week.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $180,000 to $250,000 annually.


LOCATION

Hybrid, New York, New York, United States. The role requires working in the office three days per week.
